steps.npc: This cannot stand! It's a complete outrage!
My ship! The front fell off!
Yes! That's not very typical, I'd like to make that point!
Well, there are a lot of ships going around the world all the time, and very seldom does anything like this happen!

steps.player: But then why did it happen to yours?

steps.npc: Because of that meteorologist! He didn't provide the usual weather report and we sailed right into a storm!

steps.player: And as a result the front of your ship fell off? Was your ship not safe?

steps.npc: Are you saying it's my fault?

steps.player: Well, you said yourself that this is quite a seldom occurance.

steps.npc: Look, I wouldn't say my ship wasn't safe... It just perhaps wasn't quite as safe as some of the other ones. Some of them are built so the front doesn't fall off at all.

steps.player: I see... Well, good luck with getting it all sorted.
